SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior Court
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26004014
DOCKET NO. F00166226
PLAINTIFF – PENNYMAC LOAN SERVICES, LLC
DEFENDANTS- SEGUNDO G. ESPINOZA; ET AL.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 27th DAY OF October 2026
between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of EAST ORANGE, County of Essex County and State of New Jersey:
Being known as:
LOT: 7 BLOCK: 340.01
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: 50' X 124.70'
NEAREST CROSS STREET: NORTH ARLINGTON AVENUE
PLAINTIFF UPSET BID IS $393,680.00 IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF SECTION 12 OF P.L. 1995, C.244 (C.2A:50-64) AS AMENDED. THE PROPERTY IS REPORTED TO BE OWNER OCCUPIED.
RTLF-NJ IIB, LLC HOLDS A TAX SALE CERTIFICATE IN THE AMOUNT OF $773.11 PLUS SUBSEQUENT TAXES AND INTEREST AS OF 8/13/2026.
EAST ORANGE CITY HOLDS A CLAIM IN THE AMOUNT OF $2.79 PLUS PENALTY FOR 2ND QUARTER 2026 TAXES; 4,287.81 PLUS PENALTY FOR 3RDFOR 3RD QUARTER 2026 TAXES AS OF 8/13/26.
THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND IN THE OFFICE OF THE CLERK OF ESSEX COUNTY IN INSTRUMENT NUMBER 2023021436.
SUPERIOR INTERSET (IF ANY): ANY AND ALL EASEMENTS, COVENANTS, RESTRICTIONS AND RESERVATIONS OF RECORD; ANY SET OF FACTS WHICH AN ACCURATE SURVEY AND INSPECTIONS WOULD DISCLOSE; ALL UNPAID MUNICIPAL TAXES, ASSESSMENTS AND LIENS; ANY UNPAID ASSESSMENT AND ANY OUTSTANDING TAX SALE CERTIFICATE; RIGHTS OF ANY PARTY IN POSESSION/RIGHTS PROTECTED BY THE NJ ANTI-EVICITION ACT; ALL LOCAL, COUNTY, STATE AND FEDERAL ORDINANCES AND REGULATIONS; ANY CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION LIEN GRANTES PRIORITY BY N.J.S.A. 46:8B-21B; ANY OUTSTANDING CONDOMINIUM, PUD OR HOMEOWNER ASSOCIATION DUES OR FEES; RIGHTS OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, IF ANY; THE PROPERTY IS SOLD IN ITS " AS IS" CONDITION; PURCHASER SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR SHERIFF'S COST, COMMISSION, DEED RECORDING FEES AND REALTY TRANSFER FEES; ANY SOLAR PANELS AFFIXED TO THE PROPERTY WILL NOT BE CONVEYED BY THIS SALE
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
323 SPRINGDALE AVENUE EAST ORANGE, NJ 07017
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $447,655.16 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
Advertised
DATED: September 14, 2026
POWERS KIRN, LLC
308 HARPER DRIVE
SUITE 210, P.O. BOX 848
MOORESTOWN, NJ 08057
856-802-1000
